Please suggest

3d Rendered image showing shadow effect.

original image below is desired requirement. Please suggest how can we achieve?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi,I tried and successful with edited thread texture shadow in PS. IT WORKS.👍🏻Thanks!

Comment 2: Hi. It possibly may also help if you remove the Normal Map from the Sewing where the seam is sewn together

Comment 3: hI lUCILE,Thanks for connectingIt is already off, this option of 3d , uncheck or not is doing nothing for me (myside).
Reply 1: Hi! On your screenshot, is it 2 patterns sewn together and then a topstitch on the seamline or is it just a topstitch on an internal line?If it's the first option, then you can use the Edit Sewing tool, select the sewing line and delete the normal map in the Property Editor.

Comment 4: Hi, please untick the '3D' option in the Property Editor of your top stitch and it should remove the shadow.
content_description: "Seek expert advice on achieving realistic shadow effects in 3D rendered images based on provided original references."

title: Clo x Coach contest
content:
Is it okay for one of the uploaded 'renders' of the three submitted picture is a breakdown of the bag (pockets and all) with some text about the Design Concept and Research?

![d6790db9d3c04c5ba4f82bb64ad4693f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202507/6bf75d3dafd4404ea1cd52d9db4f1ec8/images/d6790db9d3c04c5ba4f82bb64ad4693fdownload%20%2892%29.jpeg)It would be something like this (this is an image I found online) with the bag compartments 'expanded' and spread out so you could see it in detail. With a blurb of the design concept, research and reasoning?

If not where can I put this information?


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Yes! That would be great as it helps show your process 🙂
Reply 1: hello love, unfortunately I couldnt participate as my clo file got corrupted and I couldn't recover anything- I'm incredibly heartbroken over it but ill live. I would like to know if we are still allowed to post on social media as I had created an entire collection with research and such?
Reply 2: oh no! We would definitely not stop you from posting your own work though. And please tag us. We love seeing CLO Creations!
content_description: This webpage aims to clarify whether a detailed breakdown of a submitted bag design, including compartment visuals and accompanying text on its concept and research, is permissible, and to suggest appropriate alternatives for presenting this information if necessary.
